title: Session Timeout
summary: Warns before an idle session expires and lets the user stay signed in, so a timeout doesn't silently lose unsaved work.
description: Idle-timeout warning dialog with a countdown and a draining ring that turns red in the last 10 seconds, a Stay signed in action that extends the session through your callback, cross-tab activity sync and calm screen-reader announcements.
catches: Idle time approaching the timeout (warns warnBefore ms ahead)
Activity in another tab, which resets the timer (BroadcastChannel)
Sign-out in another tab, followed here
Keep-alive failures, shown while the warning stays open
limits: The client timer is advisory; the server session can still expire on its own clock
Does not save work; pair with autosave
a11y: Native <dialog> with role=alertdialog, labelled and described
Countdown is spoken only from announceAt seconds, assertively; errors use role=alert
Ring and digit animation respect reduced motion
server: Expire sessions on the server and extend them only through an authenticated keep-alive.
stops: Logged out and lost unsaved work
